decisions.rationale: The evidence does not support a stable broad later-day departure policy: one example explicitly splits an outbound morning from a return after 6 p.m., another is a one-off return-leg constraint, and only one directly expresses an afternoon-or-evening preference. Keeping it would overgeneralize leg-specific transaction constraints.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not extend this preference to arrival times or assume an exact clock time within the afternoon.
decisions.condition: When selecting or narrowing flight departure times.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize flights departing in the afternoon.
decisions.exception_condition: Use another departure period when the traveler explicitly requests it for the current leg or no workable afternoon option is available.
decisions.name: Prefers afternoon flight departures
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples consistently request afternoon departures or the closest available option, supporting a soft recurring departure-period preference without implying an exact time or arrival-time preference.
